records.source: Spirit's Eve
records.translation: Bisperas ng mga Espiritu

records.source: You'll have to tell me what's beyond, I can't go on... spiders...$s
records.translation: Kailangan mong sabihin sa akin kung ano ang nasa kabila, hindi ko na kaya... mga gagamba...$s

records.source: I may have had a little too much pumpkin ale...
records.translation: Baka naparami nang kaunti ang nainom kong serbesa ng kalabasa...

records.source: I'm confused... you go on ahead and let me figure this out.
records.translation: Nalilito ako... mauna ka na at hayaan mo akong lutasin ito.

records.source: Oh... These vapors... Hmmm... You look nice tonight.$l
records.translation: Ah... Ang mga singaw na ito... Hmmm... Maganda ka ngayong gabi.$l

records.source: I get scared easily... I think I'm just going to stay right here.$s
records.translation: Madali akong matakot... Dito na lang yata ako.$s

records.source: It would be interesting to have one of these on the farm.
records.translation: Magiging kawili-wiling magkaroon ng isa sa mga ito sa bukid.

records.source: Hey, I was wondering when you'd show up!$h
records.translation: Hoy, iniisip ko kung kailan ka darating!$h

records.source: Hi... I was hoping you'd find me here...$l
records.translation: Kumusta... Umaasa akong matatagpuan mo ako rito...$l

records.source: Mmph... I believe I've eaten a few too many slices of pumpkin pie.
records.translation: Mmph... Sa palagay ko, naparami ang nakain kong hiwa ng pie na kalabasa.

records.source: I can't go on... spiders...$s
records.translation: Hindi ko na kaya... mga gagamba...$s

records.source: Well, winter's almost here. It's a great time to stockpile wood and stone.
records.translation: Aba, malapit na ang taglamig. Magandang panahon ito para mag-ipon ng kahoy at bato.

records.source: I haven't seen Maru in hours... I hope she's alright.
records.translation: Ilang oras ko nang hindi nakikita si Maru... Sana ayos lang siya.

records.source: I think I've already been this way... no, wait...$s#$e#I'm lost...$s
records.translation: Parang napuntahan ko na ito... hindi, sandali...$s#$e#Naliligaw ako...$s

records.source: I have no idea how these skeletons are walking... creepy.#$e#It's pretty cool though.
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung paano naglalakad ang mga kalansay na ito... nakakatakot.#$e#Pero kahanga-hanga rin.

records.preserveReason: Punctuation-only confused reaction; preserving “??” retains the intended nonlexical response.

records.source: I get scared very easily. I'll leave the haunted maze to the younger people.
records.translation: Napakadali kong matakot. Ipaubaya ko na sa mga nakababata ang labirintong pinamumugaran ng multo.

records.source: Good show, old friend.
records.translation: Mahusay, kaibigan kong matagal na.

records.source: There's something weird over there. But how do I get to it?#$e#There's gotta be a secret passage somewhere around here.
records.translation: May kakaiba roon. Pero paano ako makararating doon?#$e#Tiyak na may lihim na daanan sa paligid dito.

records.source: Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.$h
records.translation: Hmm... pinausukang hita ng pabo? Mukhang hindi naman ganap na masama ang pistang ito.$h

records.source: I wish Gus would include a vegetarian option. Some zucchini skewers, maybe?
records.translation: Sana magdagdag si Gus ng pagkaing walang karne. Baka mga tuhog na zucchini?

records.source: Good evening, @. Have you ventured into the haunted maze yet? It's quite spooky.#$e#That strange man who lives in the tower set it all up himself. He wouldn't let anyone near while he was working on it.
records.translation: Magandang gabi, @. Nakipagsapalaran ka na ba sa labirintong pinamumugaran ng multo? Talagang nakakatakot iyon.#$e#Ang kakaibang lalaking nakatira sa tore ang mag-isang naghanda ng lahat. Hindi niya pinayagang lumapit ang sinuman habang ginagawa niya iyon.

records.source: One of my iridium-infused maces would make quick work of these things.
records.translation: Mabilis na lilipulin ng isa sa mga maso kong pinatibay ng iridyum ang mga ito.

records.source: Do you like the jack-o-lanterns? I carved them myself.
records.translation: Gusto mo ba ang mga Parol na Kalabasa? Ako mismo ang umukit sa mga iyon.

records.source: The vapor from this cauldron... it's making my head spin, but I can't seem to leave...$u
records.translation: Ang singaw mula sa kalderong ito... nahihilo ako rito, pero parang hindi ako makaalis...$u

records.source: I'll come to any event with free grub! You won't see me in the haunted maze, though.
records.translation: Pupunta ako sa anumang okasyong may libreng pagkain! Pero hindi mo ako makikita sa labirintong pinamumugaran ng multo.

records.source: Eek! I'm too scared.$s
records.translation: Eek! Takot na takot ako.$s

records.source: Vincent's upset that I won't let him go into the haunted maze... but he's just a little boy!
records.translation: Naiinis si Vincent dahil ayaw ko siyang papasukin sa labirintong pinamumugaran ng multo... pero napakabata pa niya!

records.source: Hey, @. Nice evening, isn't it?
records.translation: Hoy, @. Maganda ang gabi, hindi ba?

records.source: That's odd... It's just a dead end up ahead.#$e#I could've sworn there was someone ahead of me when I went through the maze, though. Where'd they go?
records.translation: Kakaiba... Sarado ang daan sa unahan.#$e#Pero panunumpaan kong may tao sa unahan ko nang dumaan ako sa labirinto. Saan siya nagpunta?

records.source: Mm, hi. Sorry... mouth full of blackberries.
records.translation: Mm, kumusta. Pasensiya na... punô ng blackberry ang bibig ko.

records.source: Hi, @. Have you had a productive fall?#$e#It's starting to get quite cold... crops won't hold out for much longer.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Naging masagana ba ang taglagas mo?#$e#Nagsisimula nang lumamig nang husto... hindi na magtatagal ang mga pananim.

records.source: Why, hello @. It's chilly, isn't it?
records.translation: Aba, kumusta, @. Malamig, hindi ba?

records.source: It's a lot of fun to cook with pumpkin. Such an interesting fruit.
records.translation: Napakasayang magluto gamit ang kalabasa. Napakawili nitong prutas.

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: The affairs of mundane folk matter little to me, but the elementals like a chance to see you up close.#$e#It was for them that I created this silly maze.
records.translation: Hindi gaanong mahalaga sa akin ang mga gawain ng karaniwang tao, pero gusto ng mga elemental ang pagkakataong makita ka nang malapitan.#$e#Para sa kanila ko ginawa ang nakakatawang labirintong ito.

records.source: Oh! You found me...$8#$b#The truth is, I got too scared so I came here to hide. Don't tell anyone.$s
records.translation: Ah! Natagpuan mo ako...$8#$b#Ang totoo, natakot ako nang husto kaya nagtago ako rito. Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman.$s

records.source: Why is there no more pumpkin ale?
records.translation: Bakit wala nang serbesa ng kalabasa?

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: But Aunt Marnie! I wanna go in the maze! I'm not scared!$s
records.translation: Pero Tita Marnie! Gusto kong pumasok sa labirinto! Hindi ako natatakot!$s

records.source: Mother won't let me go in the maze. *sob*$s
records.translation: Ayaw akong papasukin ni Nanay sa labirinto. *hikbi*$s

records.source: Don't get too close to the cage.
records.translation: Huwag kang masyadong lumapit sa hawla.

records.source: %Leo's unblinking eyes are glued to the screen. You're unable to get his attention.
records.translation: %Nakatitig sa tabing ang mga matang hindi kumukurap ni Leo. Hindi mo makuha ang pansin niya.

records.source: Have you ever fought any of these monsters before?$0#$e#Even... the s-spiders?$2
records.translation: Nakalaban mo na ba dati ang alinman sa mga halimaw na ito?$0#$e#Kahit... ang m-mga gagamba?$2

records.source: I probably had too much pumpkin ale before jumping into the maze.$2#$e#You go on ahead. I'll catch up.$0
records.translation: Baka naparami ang nainom kong serbesa ng kalabasa bago ako sumugod sa labirinto.$2#$e#Mauna ka na. Susunod ako.$0
